results.name: Bank of America Corp.
results.description: Bank of America Corp. is an American multinational banking and financial services corporation. It is the second largest bank holding company in the United States by assets. The company was founded in 1874.

results.name: BacTech Environmental Corp.
results.description: BacTech Environmental Corp. was incorporated on October 5, 2010 in Canada. The company specializes in environmental remediation technologies, specifically focusing on the treatment of mine tailings and other industrial waste.

results.name: Africa Bitcoin Corp. Ltd.
results.description: Africa Bitcoin Corp. Ltd. (formerly Altvest Capital Ltd.) is an investment holding company. It provides funding to South African businesses includes funding of SMEs in South Africa and encourages the participation of retail investors in the financial markets by allowing them to invest in bespoke investments. The company was founded on April 21, 2021.

results.name: Camsing Healthcare Ltd.
results.description: Camsing Healthcare Ltd. formerly Jacks International Ltd. operates as a holding company engaged in distribution and retail of health foods and supplements. The company was incorporated on December 19, 1979 and is a subsidiary of Abacus Pacific N.V. since September 08, 1987 and was acquired by Creative Elite Holdings Ltd. on November 18, 2015.
